Hm. forph sult. My muel estumo funo, M. A.Y. Chezit, ii donno of obtamin an appontment as Jeey Maste or as Connin say of Intontamo si The H.S. Army. us Claget has long ben a undent Lorscillo, and A lanovo him to be a mao of trict etypity, anco vi also propped. fue buamp capacely and of mdude kabit. In a voi

si altogethe wor of putti ance posiate cospidemo & you can be of any servie to hai ni attainy hui ojit you rele much oblige

zous truly

4202
